resource: Foundation-owned retained terminal semantic records for one GameSession
allocation_impact: Before gameplay mutation whose accepted semantics require replayable retained evidence, either admit the bounded terminal semantic record within the session limit or fail closed. Pending commands are not retention entries and cannot be evicted. A second simultaneously retained terminal record may exist only after deterministic eviction of an eligible terminal record; otherwise admission fails before mutation.
boundary_tests: 1 retained terminal semantic record is accepted
2 simultaneously retained terminal semantic records are never admitted
pending command state is never evicted to satisfy terminal-retention capacity
terminal eviction never lowers next_command_id or makes a CommandRef reservable again
notes: Current first-playable hard maximum established by protected #665 evidence; not derived from FND02 outstanding-command, NET03, fixture or TTL limits.
